entries.subject: Buie occultation/lightcurve ellipsoid
entries.finding: The selected full axes are 117 × 108 × 90 km, halved for the analytic model. They are a three-dimensional inference distinct from the observed 117.2 × 93 km projected limb; no independent axis errors are invented.

entries.subject: Discrepant negative occultation chords
entries.finding: Ambiguous negative chords and unarchived tapes do not establish a crater or local void on Menoetius. No local shape depression is inferred.
entries.revisitWhen: Original timing/chord evidence resolves the discrepancy and supports a reproducible local feature.

entries.subject: JPL number 82 system placement and synchronous interpretation
entries.finding: The fixed-epoch state uses its matching primary center. The 2024 orbital pole supplies an approximate synchronous spin axis; longitude is arbitrary and runtime extrapolation is disabled.

entries.subject: Occultation, lightcurves and artist surfaces
entries.finding: The examined occultation/lightcurve material supports shape inference, not a measured surface texture. NASA artist models and the primary Patroclus parameters do not supply Menoetius terrain.
entries.revisitWhen: Actual resolved Menoetius imagery with qualified registration or a measured surface product is available.
